design_parameters.enrich_notes: MMSD Ch 13 (Jul 2020): GI detention for 5,000 sf to ½ acre net new impervious is 0.5 in × net new impervious area (sec. 13.302(3)(c)). Detention credit table (13.303(4)(b)): Bioswale 7.5 gal/sf, Constructed wetlands 8.3, Green roof 1.0, Porous pavement 3.0, Rain garden 4.4 gal/sf. GI construction per WI DNR post-construction standards URL cited in sec. 13.303(4)(c). Larger sites (≥½ acre new impervious) use allowable release rate or volume match, not the 0.5 in GI rule.
